original_ai_output.title_zh: 专家捐赠除颤器并推动全国心肺复苏培训以减少猝死
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚心脏病学专家向阿布贾大学捐赠一台公共除颤器，并呼吁在全国范围内加强心肺复苏培训，以减少心脏性猝死。活动在世界重启心脏日之际举行，由阿布贾大学医疗中心与公共卫生与社会发展学会组织。专家表示，仅靠心肺复苏培训不够，还需教会公众使用公共除颤器。

key_facts.fact: 心脏病学专家向阿布贾大学捐赠一台公共除颤器
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Cardiology experts have donated a public access defibrillator to the University of Abuja

key_facts.fact: 专家呼吁在全国范围内加强心肺复苏培训以减少心脏性猝死
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: intensified calls for nationwide Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) training to reduce sudden cardiac deaths in Nigeria

key_facts.fact: 活动在世界重启心脏日之际于阿布贾举行
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: during the World Restart a Heart Day celebration organised by the University of Abuja Medical Centre and the Society for Public Health and Social Development (SPHSD) on Saturday in Abuja

key_facts.fact: 专家称仅靠心肺复苏培训不够，还需教会公众使用公共除颤器
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: CPR training alone was insufficient without teaching people how to use public access defibrillators during cardiac emergencies

uncertainties: 单一来源报道，尚未获得其他来源交叉验证
